proposal.reasoning_trace: card:icici is effectively down at 4% success over 214 attempts against a 90% baseline, with the breaker already half-open, and no Razorpay downtime notice covers it. The code names the gateway layer and the collapse is confined to this path, so the fault is between the mesh and the issuer rather than at the issuer. Attempt 3 failing identically rules out a one-off switch error. No session is open, so recovery is a scheduling problem: retry on card after 15m, which is how long gateway faults of this shape usually take to clear. This is the last attempt the stop rule permits, so it is spent after the window rather than inside it.
